hooks.command: if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ]; then takoctl status set working --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" --text "Thinking..." >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress indeterminate --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :
if [ -n "$TAKO_SOCKET" ]; then takoctl status set idle --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; takoctl progress clear --target "$TAKO_SURFACE_ID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; :
